title: Reduced in Bed Rest After Coronary Arteriography or Coronary Angioplasty
brief_summary: This is a randomized clinical trial with a control group, based on the guidelines of the CONSORT 2010. The interventional group will be in a bed rest for two hours after introducer removal in patients submitted a coronary arteriography or coronary angioplasty and the control group will follow the standard nursing care for four hours.
